headline: Executive order sets up a temporary federal organization to support a strategic partnership between the United States and Iraq.
what_it_does: This order creates a temporary organization within the federal government to help carry out a strategic partnership with the Republic of Iraq. No summary was provided, so details such as the organization's exact duties, staffing, and how long it lasts are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and employees working on US–Iraq relations
who_it_affects.how: They may be assigned to or work with the new temporary organization set up to support the partnership.
It is the partner the new organization is meant to work with.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely on signing, May 7, 2010 (not stated in the source material)
